name: La Maison d'Or
description: An elegant French bistro offering classic dishes in an intimate setting with vintage decor and soft lighting. Known for their wine selection and house-made pastries.

name: Sushi Wave
description: Modern Japanese restaurant specializing in creative rolls and fresh sashimi. Features a sleek minimalist design with a prominent sushi bar and peaceful zen garden.

name: The Rustic Spoon
description: Farm-to-table American cuisine served in a cozy, rustic atmosphere. Featuring exposed brick walls, wooden beams, and an open kitchen concept.
